topics.question: When does an old approval stop authorizing a new action?
topics.boundary: historical approval != current authority after material conditions change
topics.ja_question: 「前に承認した」は、今も実行してよいという意味か

topics.question: What should an agent do when an external action may have succeeded but the response was lost?
topics.boundary: local error != proof of external non-execution
topics.ja_question: エラーが出たら、同じ外部操作をもう一度してよいのか

topics.question: Do many links represent many independent evidence roots?
topics.boundary: surface source count != independent evidence-root count
topics.ja_question: 10本の記事が一致したら、10個の独立証拠なのか

topics.question: When upstream evidence is corrected, what downstream beliefs must change?
topics.boundary: corrected source + stale derived state can reproduce the old error
topics.ja_question: 原資料が訂正されたのに、古い結論だけ残っていないか

topics.question: Did the system really work, or did one visible layer merely succeed?
topics.boundary: surface output exists != necessary causal path established
topics.ja_question: 「動いた」「数字が出た」は、本当に全体が成立したのか

topics.question: Is today's benefit borrowing from tomorrow's options?
topics.boundary: current benefit -> unresolved residual -> future settlement
topics.ja_question: 今日の利益は、明日の選択肢を先に使っていないか

topics.question: Is more disclosure actually making a decision easier to verify?
topics.ja_question: 開示資料が増えたのに、なぜ意思決定を追えないのか

topics.question: When does expertise become verification immunity?
topics.boundary: expertise deserves weight != expertise is exempt from verification
topics.ja_question: 専門家を尊重することと、検証を止めることは同じか

topics.question: Can a rational defensive action create the next threat it is trying to stop?
topics.boundary: local self-protection can amplify mutually coupled threat
topics.ja_question: 合理的な防衛行動が、次の脅威を自分で作っていないか

topics.question: Did the subject change, or did the measurement surface change?
topics.ja_question: 対象が変わったのか、測定面が変わったのか

topics.question: Are separate reviewer or auditor roles actually independent enough to reopen and correct a decision?
topics.boundary: role separation != causal independence; audit output != correction capability
topics.ja_question: 監査役・評価者・AIを別に置けば、それだけで独立した検証になるのか
